svg.text: UniFi · Proxmox VE on a spare laptop · example addressing, not real values
Ethernet nic0 → switch trunk · native Mgmt, tagged Lab (80)
Power groups (start only what you need)
netbox on demand, grafana always on
• Management (VLAN 10) is the native network on the Proxmox trunk port; only Lab (80) is tagged.
• DC2 has a single NIC on vmbr1, so it only talks to DC1's second NIC. It can't reach siem, so it sends no logs.
• lab-targets (metasploitable2, docker-targets, badblood-dc) is set to No Internet in UniFi; the rest of the Lab can get out.
• badblood-dc is a separate throwaway forest for attack practice. Keep it off unless you are using it.
• Kali runs in virt-manager on the workstation (Trusted) and reaches the Lab through the firewall.
• Lab /27 has 29 host addresses after the gateway and 9 are in use. Plan a larger Lab subnet before adding more.
